note: Captured once from the published effect-dynamodb@1.40.0 and @effect-dynamodb/schema@1.40.0, installed outside the repo and run by a scratch script against DynamoDB Local. For each union field F, entities Doc_F (plain) and Kept_F (versioned: { retain: true }), pk id, model { id, F }, the fields: unions every member of which holds the path's next segment (pass, pass2 untagged, outer, outer2 with a second union inside), unions under a list and a record of another union (passList, passRec, list, rec), a union inside another union's member (two), members with optional and with overlapping properties (opt, over, wide), set-valued members (bag), Schema.Class members (cls), members renaming their keys with encodeKeys (renamed, whose paths 1.40.0 wrote by the names given) and a member with an OptionFromNullOr property (optn). Rows a (the union as its first member) and b (as its second), seeded by put on the one entity the case writes. For each update of path operations, on each entity (Docs: Doc_F, Kept: Kept_F), each row, alone and in Transaction.transactWrite: its outcome, every request it sent, whole, in order, the rows after it and what get read back, and for a failure its operation and cause as text; the table's name is <table>, UUIDs <token> and timestamps <time>. Never regenerate it: it is the record of what 1.40.0 did.
